wiki.title: Seth Bongartz
wiki.extract: Seth Bongartz (born 23 September 1954) is an American politician and a member of the Democratic Party who has served in the Vermont Senate since 2025. He previous service in the state legislature includes the Vermont House of Representatives from 1981 to 1985, the Vermont Senate from 1987 to 1989, and the Vermont House from 2021 to 2025.
